label: Proper-part omission audit of the uniter-to-esse bridge
summary: Scoped follow-up to #1751/#1810 and the qualified 2026-11-18 union-bundle reassessment. The original Bool omission of fbee7f15 allowed the composite itself as one of its numerically distinct ComponentOf components. That proof was logically valid but did not discriminate the stronger q.11 a.1 proper-part reading. The expanded Article7Uniting.Control.Certificate adds a nondegenerate Fin 4 interpretation: the inhabited whole 3 has two components 0 and 1, each demonstrably distinct from whole 3; a third individual 2 is a non-self efficient uniter and actual Unites tuples exist. The fixture has two respects (Bool, esse = true): 2 efficiently causes 3 only in the non-esse respect false, efficient causing in a respect is certified to be CausesIn in that same respect, and nothing causes 3 in respect esse. The other four union inputs hold, while CausesIn at esse is empty and ca07cae9 fails. Independent semantic challenge at 386ddc266c: the first draft used Unit as the only respect, so its uniter literally efficiently caused 3's esse under the secunda-via gloss and the fixture separated only two unlinked causal primitives at esse; adding the inclusion of efficient causing in CausesIn would have defeated it. Repaired by the two-respect fixture above, which satisfies that inclusion. The legacy fourth Bool control has the same single-respect feature; it stays a valid formal omission of the encoded premise but does not by itself separate an efficient composer from a giver of esse. This is a strengthened formal independence control, not an assertion that any ontology actually has this relation. Reused the existing Certificate/Challenge/solution and all unchanged Five-Way union consequences; no new premise, intermediate graph leaf, witness switch or proof of fbee7f15. Repaired the q.11 component statement and both originating Lean declaration comments to match the types exactly: ca07cae9 demands a numerically distinct cause of esse but does not assert that the selected witness is a uniter, presently actual or a nonpart; 6b80cfe4 merely requires different components, not both proper. Deliberately retained the historically source-linked ca07cae9 statement paraphrase rather than fabricating new source attribution for the interpretive cause-of-esse strengthening; the limitation is explicit in the Lean comment and linked current assessment. Added a truthful q.11 source attribution for the changed, weaker component statement. Re-read existing pinned q.3 a.7/q.11 a.1 scope records and SCG I.18 n.4 support relation; they do not state the uniter-to-esse claim. The same-bearer productive-source interpretation is a positive path to warrant but is not a theorem or direct source attribution. Prior qualified pro-composition assessment and strong immanent rival preserved. Kernel/Comparator/CI certification is pending at creation of this record; only after those pass does the extended certificate become verified. No substantive status grade or root frontier change is proposed. Same-slice consequence: added compositeHasSameUnitingEsseCause, which preserves the same witnessed a,b,c satisfying ComponentOf, Unites, c ≠ x and CausesIn c x esse. The registered ca07cae9 theorem now simply projects from this stronger lemma; it adds no premise or new root route, and it does not prove c's presence at the selected world. This removes an avoidable witness-erasure ambiguity without asserting an actual-world correspondence. Priority 8 continuation (2026-11-24), composition-causal-scope.md, ‘When the work of maintaining unity passes from an assembler to a constituent’: a two-phase load-transfer control verifies the registered distinct-cause formula separately in each selected phase, while there is no fixed supplier across phases and the only late supplier is a proper constituent on the specified role reading. Three locally checked zero-axiom lemmas. Restricted productive warrant requires identity/persistence evidence that disruption ends this unit, alongside actual production of its constitution. A transition that disables one operation of a continuing bearer does not supply that warrant. No universal efficient existential bridge or new graph argument.
blocker: Still OPEN: for a genuinely existing same composite x, why does an efficient cause of its constituent union also produce or sustain x’s positive esse, rather than merely its form, arrangement or generative event? The current-world actuality/correspondence interfaces and the whole-first restriction/reception bridge remain independent. Next substantive comparison: #1810 with #1811 on that same x and same existential causal relation; repeating the old Bool omission fixture alone does not answer it.

current_assessment.scope: Source-faithfulness and formal independence for the third-proof union-to-esse package when the two components are proper and the nonself uniter is efficient. This refines the existing #1751 11/18 and #1728 11/17 assessments, without replacing their substantive warrant grades.
current_assessment.assessment: The earlier six Bool fixtures showed conditional independence only for the weaker numerical-diversity encoding (which permitted one component identical to the whole). The new Fin 4 model makes both constituents proper, ensures a third distinct efficient uniter and a witnessed union, has the uniter efficiently cause the composite only in a non-esse respect, and counts that efficient causing as CausesIn in the same respect, yet no cause of the composite's esse. The logical need for fbee7f15 therefore survives the faithful proper-part test and the inclusion of efficient causing in CausesIn; what the bridge adds is the passage from the respect of union to the respect of esse. The OPEN existential-production bridge remains the same shared assumption in all five ca07cae9 support bundles. A positive Thomistic causal-production or participation explanation remains a plausible conditional option; a positive immanent/whole-first constitutional rival is not thereby defeated, and must answer the same positive-existence question. The root also needs actual-world presence and causal correspondence. Earlier 2026-11-18 restricted positive warrant, direct primitive support and qualified positive preference for the composition route are retained without grading change. Neither premise nor root is closed; the seventh control is a formal non-entailment test, not a metaphysical counterexample. The separately exposed stronger theorem now preserves that the c causing esse is the very c uniting the components, in the conditional derivation; its registered weaker conclusion used to erase this evidence. It does not discharge the world-local mapping.
current_assessment.next_test: For an actual composition-bearing x, distinguish the efficient producer of the union, the immanent formal cause of its substantial unity, and a distinct current producer of that very x’s esse. Identify and assess the specific productive-existence bridge (or a weaker local sufficient sibling) and carry the same c,x to the selected-world presence/correspondence interface. Compare with the positive necessary whole-first/reception account under #1810/#1811. Only a substantive difference from this two-respect proper-part model (for example a sourced reason why the respect in which a uniter efficiently causes a composite must be esse) warrants reopening the omission test. Reuse the stronger same-c lemma when formalizing any selected-world composition application, rather than pretending the old registered conclusion retains its uniter witness.
current_assessment.evidence: Proposed additive control and witness-preserving auxiliary theorem at the PR head; the independent semantic challenge of head 386ddc266c raised one P1 (the single Unit respect collapsed efficient causing of the composite into esse), repaired by the two-respect fixture; delivered-head CI pending. The earlier 2026-11-18 accepted-qualified judgment is not altered.
current_assessment.supersedes: Only the sufficiency of the old six Bool interpretation controls as a test of genuine proper-part union, if previously read that way. Their formal independence claims remain valid. The qualified 2026-11-18 premise-warrant assessment and 2026-11-17 connected pure-actuality assessment are explicitly not superseded.
